---
name: Feature Request or Suggestion
about: Suggest an idea, new content, or an improvement for this project.
title: '[SUGGESTION] '
labels: enhancement
---

### What is your idea or suggestion?

A clear and concise description of what you'd like to see added or changed.
_(e.g., "Add a link to your LinkedIn profile in the footer," or "Consider adding a blog section.")_

### Why would this be helpful? (Optional)

If you'd like, explain the problem this feature would solve or the benefit it would provide.
_(e.g., "It would make it easier for recruiters to connect," or "It would allow you to share more detailed thoughts.")_

### Additional Context

Add any other context, examples, or screenshots about the feature request here.
